core/utils/dom.ts

Shadow-piercing DOM queries + the SVG placeholder helper.
Source src/core/utils/dom.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

(module scope)

Any node that can host a subtree worth scanning.

_root

document when it exists, null in non-DOM contexts (SSR/test shims).

deepQuerySelector

Depth-first search for the FIRST element matching selector, descending through every nested shadow root it passes. Order matches the visual document order (parents before their shadow children). Recursion — not a hand-rolled stack — matches the self-similar tree shape per repo rule 20.

  • @param selector CSS selector.
  • @param root Subtree root; defaults to document when present.
  • @returns First match or null.

deepQuerySelectorAll

Same traversal as deepQuerySelector but collects EVERY match across all shadow trees — used for sweeps like "pause every video on the page". The results array is threaded through recursion (accumulator style) so no intermediate arrays get concatenated per level.

  • @param selector CSS selector.
  • @param root Subtree root; defaults to document.
  • @param results Accumulator — internal recursion state, omit externally.
  • @returns All matching elements in visual document order.

withinModalArmWindow

Whether now still falls inside a just-mounted overlay's input-arm window. Dialogs and the menu mount synchronously during the opening gesture's dispatch, so a residual press from that same gesture — the second click of an in-place double-click, or a mouseup retargeted onto freshly mounted controls — lands inside the overlay and fires whatever happens to sit under the cursor (a language option, the dismiss backdrop). Capture-phase guards consult this before letting pointer input through; a non-positive openedAt disarms the window entirely.

  • @param openedAt performance.now() sampled on the open transition.
  • @param now Sample time — defaults to the shared time-origin clock.
  • @returns True while pointer input inside the overlay should be swallowed.

(module scope)

Minimal host surface the residual-input guard needs.

addScopedListener

Scoped listener registration (BaseComponent.addScopedListener).

armResidualInputGuard

Attaches the residual-input guard to an overlay host — a capture-phase click/pointerdown pair on the host element itself, so a swallowed event never descends into the shadow tree toward option, backdrop, or widget handlers. The guard is inert while the overlay reports closed.

Event discrimination:

  • Only MouseEvent-typed input can be gesture residue — plain Event('click') dispatches are scripted/deliberate and always pass.
  • click carries a meaningful detail: 0 marks keyboard/programmatic activation (deliberate — always passes, keeping tests' .click() working); ≥2 marks a multi-click residual — stale by definition.
  • pointer presses carry no click count and are armed by the time window alone; this also covers drags started by a stale pointerdown (e.g. the theme slider's window-tracked drag).
  • @param host Overlay host element (also the listener owner).
  • @param isOpen Predicate — the guard is inert while the overlay is closed.
  • @param openedAt Clock accessor — performance.now() sampled at open.

svgPlaceholder

Generates an ultra-lightweight inline SVG placeholder data URI with exact dimensions. An empty <svg width height viewBox> weighs ~110 bytes, decodes instantly, and — crucially — gives the <img> a definite intrinsic size AND aspect ratio, so width:auto layouts reserve the real natural box while the actual image streams in (zero CLS, no uniform-width stretching). Without the width/height attrs the SVG is intrinsic-ratio-only and the img collapses to the ~300×150 default replaced size. Default is FHD 1920×1080 (16:9), the common media shape. encodeURIComponent (not base64) keeps the URI readable and is the spec-supported form for data:image/svg+xml per RFC 2397 — b64 would inflate size ~33%.

  • @param w Intrinsic width to declare (px).
  • @param h Intrinsic height to declare (px).
  • @returns data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,… URI for img.src.
